about: The models a batch runs. Every teammate's program reads this file from GitHub's main, so a change here reaches everyone without pulling. Each model gets a one-word test first, and models an account can't use are skipped.

sources.claude: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config: aliases always mean the newest model (the run records the exact model used); 5.5 models and Fable 5.1 accept low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
sources.codex: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models: gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-luna are the recommended Codex models. Luna supports efforts up to max (not ultra); Sol goes from low (Light) to ultra, and max/ultra depend on your settings.
sources.agy: agy 1.4.2 `agy --help` (checked 2026-10-20): --effort takes low|medium|high|xhigh|max; `agy models` lists this account's models once signed in. Model names that end in an effort (e.g. -high) fix the effort themselves.

optional_models.fable: may bill paid usage credits instead of your plan's limits
